schema.name: CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset
schema.description: Cubeless native editor diagnostics, asset verification and compiler operations. Never reference this editor class from game assets.

tools.description:
Read imported skeletal mesh sections for one LOD, including enabled state and source section identity.
SkeletalMeshPath is an object path such as /Game/Meshes/SK_Test.SK_Test; LODIndex is zero-based.
Returns JSON matching the legacy GetSections data fields plus operation status. Loads the mesh but never edits or saves it.
If mesh compilation is pending, returns a retryable read error instead of forcing synchronous compilation.
tools.name: CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset.GetSkeletalMeshSections

tools.description: Return JSON with engine/project identity, dirty packages, PIE state and MCP plugin state. Does not save, compile, close, or modify assets.
tools.name: CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset.GetEditorDiagnostics

tools.description:
Audit saved package dependencies for Cubeless, legacy MCP, official MCP, Toolset Registry, Python and EditorScriptingUtilities references.
PackageNames are long package names such as /Game/Tests/BP_Test, without object suffixes.
Includes hard and soft package references. Optional recursion has a strict MaxPackages budget (1..4096).
Returns JSON containing edges, violations, incomplete reasons and dirty packages. Incomplete scans never pass.
Saved Asset Registry data only: not proof of unsaved object references, all possible editor-only classes, or plugin-free packaging.
tools.name: CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset.AuditPackageDependencies

            static_mesh: Nonempty /Engine or /Game StaticMesh package/object path, default /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube.Cube. The complete object path must be at most 1023 UTF-16 units. Omission selects Cube; null/empty do not clear. Native class, dependency and actual property readback guards apply. General set_component_property with JSON null is a distinct clear operation.
            operation_id: Optional durable ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. This named operation keeps its own journal identity. Replay never executes again; unknown results are not automatically retried.

        Returns:
            Standard mutation outcome plus data.component, requested_static_mesh and native property observations. legacy_internal_material_supported=false and full_legacy_command_parity=false explicitly retain the unported internal option. No atomic rollback is promised.

Read-only/internal/unsupported properties fail; no raw aggregate ImportText fallback.

FVector accepts [X,Y,Z] or one broadcast number; FRotator requires [Pitch,Yaw,Roll]; FLinearColor requires [R,G,B,A]; these values have magnitude at most 1e12. Enums accept a declared name or value. StaticMeshComponent.StaticMesh accepts a checked /Engine or /Game StaticMesh path encoded as a JSON string, or null to clear. Other UObject/class assignments are unsupported. Maximum 65536 UTF-16 units, depth 8 and 1024 values; duplicate/nonfinite/numeric magnitude beyond 2^53-1/NUL/surrogate inputs fail before dispatch.

tools.description:
Add one local SCS component with validated initial properties and observed hierarchy. Initial support is a runtime-safe /Game Actor Blueprint and seven exact Engine classes; inherited/native templates, arbitrary plugin classes and external property propagation remain unsupported. Never saves. Unlike legacy's ignored component_properties, unsupported values fail explicitly.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Exact /Game Blueprint package/object path or simple name under /Game/Blueprints. Selectors are at most 1023 UTF-16 units without controls; native name/template-slot guards can be stricter.
            component_type: Runtime Engine SceneComponent, StaticMeshComponent, CameraComponent, SpringArmComponent, SphereComponent, BoxComponent or CapsuleComponent. Their U-prefix, /Script/Engine class path and short base-name aliases resolve to the same exact native class.
            component_name: Requested exact new local component variable name: ASCII identifier with 1..100 characters, not None. Existing/conflicting names fail without silently generating a different identity.
            location_json: JSON string [X,Y,Z], default [0,0,0]. Exactly three finite numbers, not booleans; magnitude at most 1e12.
            rotation_json: JSON string [Pitch,Yaw,Roll], default [0,0,0], with the same numeric bounds.
            scale_json: JSON string [X,Y,Z], default [1,1,1], with the same numeric bounds.
            parent_component: Optional exact existing local scene parent. Omitted/null/empty uses the sole local scene root, typically DefaultSceneRoot. Multiple roots require an explicit parent; an empty valid SCS may create its first root.
            component_properties_json: Explicit JSON-object adapter for legacy heterogeneous properties, default {}. At most 64 fields. Native typed scalar/vector/rotator/color/enum/name/string/text subset only; arbitrary aggregates/object/class references unsupported except checked StaticMeshComponent.StaticMesh. Shape fields: SphereRadius, BoxExtent (three numbers or broadcast number), CapsuleRadius and CapsuleHalfHeight; sizes must be finite, nonnegative and at most 1e12, with capsule radius <= half-height. Both capsule fields may be supplied together. Use the transform arguments for RelativeLocation/RelativeRotation/RelativeScale3D; conflicting property fields fail. JSON text at most 65536 UTF-16 units, depth 8 and 1024 values; duplicate keys, nonfinite/numeric magnitude beyond 2^53-1, NUL and unpaired surrogates fail before dispatch. Property names at most 1023 UTF-16 units.
            compile_blueprint: True preserves legacy's full compile boundary with diagnostics and SkipSave. False explicitly defers full compile for authoring batches; implicit structural engine work is separately reported. Finish the batch with one named compile action.
            operation_id: Optional durable ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. Same ID and normalized arguments replay its recorded result. Interrupted or uncertain operations never automatically retry.
